body:
The public repository needs a reviewable record of its filtered history before preview CI is enabled. This adds the publication audit, source-to-public commit mapping, retained-image verification and observed public branch tips. Only the unlicensed café reference is omitted from public history; the complete original repository remains local.

This also carries the owner's latest direction into Stage 0: a live shared world built from contributed code, with market-specific work on hold and the orange rule removed. Skeleton and platform work continue.

All seven local checks pass: formatting, types, lint, leaf tests, production builds, native runtime tests and the production-entry browser flow. Remote CI remains unverified: GitHub had created no workflow run or check suite as of 18:23 UTC on October 12 after PR creation and one reopen. Repository Actions and both workflows are enabled; no configuration defect or external cause has been established. Cloudflare preview deployment remains disabled until its scoped credential setup is complete; no production deployment is configured.

Stage 0 remains in progress. The external renderer, tone/proportion choices and live-provider gates retain their separate acceptance requirements.
title: Record public export and current Stage 0 direction
